decision: No duration-only replacement for the current TP8 pilot: 30 minutes is a collection target, not an evaluator admission requirement.
qualification: This establishes usable window inputs, not adequate statistical power, duration-invariant behavior or long-horizon robustness. The full-length pilot milestone remains incomplete.
future_continuity_criteria: A specified uninterrupted horizon is part of the experiment, such as a matched full-run comparison.
Repeated slow synchronization or learning cycles do not fit in existing captures.
Long-horizon alert persistence or sustained serving/HPC behavior is under test.
next_collection_priority: Fresh independent seeds and matched controls; retain interrupted captures. Prefer standard provisioning when an explicit uninterrupted horizon is required, with bounded runtime and shutdown.

cloud.physical_capacity: Not allocated or tested; sufficient quota is not proof of available hardware.

list_price.excludes: Startup, smoke, upload/teardown time, disks, networking and account-specific taxes/discounts.
